text:
Maya R.: p95 on hosted-api spiked ~110-160ms around 09:12 UTC for ~4m. Graphs show queue depth creeping on frontend queue. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
opsbot: alert hosted.p95 > 120ms triggered (09:12:34 UTC). Alert details: p95=157ms, p99=310ms, CPU=60%, queue_depth=42.
Samir: I can grab profiling traces. Initial guess: batching window widened, maybe kernel fallback to aux. Checking kselector logs.
Jihoon: I see increased KV cache miss rate for tenant 'twilio-integration' on node gpunode-12. Miss rate jump +28% around 09:10.
Maya R.: good call. Could noisy tenant be causing queue head-of-line blocking?
Zara: linking perf dashboards: http://grafana/redwood/d/hosted/latency?from=09:00&to=09:20 :pinched_fingers:
Samir: pulled pprof CPU flame for host gpunode-12. Hot path: select_kernel -> coalesce_batches -> infer_loop. Notably select_kernel falling back to `aux_k` for 2048-seqlen buckets at ~30%.
Samir: pprof snippet:
```
# top 20 flat
0.32s  12.5%  select_kernel
0.18s   7.0%  coalesce_batches
0.10s   4.0%  copy_kv_cache
```
Jihoon: KV cache eviction spiked too; eviction_cnt 1243 -> 4231 in 2m, and free_slots oscillating. Looks like thrash.
Louis: rate limiter side: small token throughput bump but no global ratecap flips. local bucket backpressure did engage on a few routers.
Maya R.: action items: 1) drain gpunode-12 from hot tenant 2) temporarily force kselector to prefer primary kernel for short runs 3) bump kvcache retention threshold 4) collect 10m traces and pprofs.
Zara: started a canary drain on gpunode-12, routing tag applied: avoid-node-12. Rolling 10% traffic away now.
opsbot: deploy rollback initiated: kselector v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 on cluster-hosted (09:16 UTC).
opsbot: deploy rollback completed (09:18 UTC).
Samir: after rollback+drain, p95 down to ~85ms, queue depth back to 6. Kernel fallback rate dropped from ~30% -> ~3%.
Jihoon: KV miss rate reduced after eviction tuning and reduced pressure from tenant. Eviction thrash appears to have been amplifying batching latency.
Maya R.: good recovery. Please upload any raw pprofs/traces to the archive and we'll do a short postmortem tomorrow.
Zara: pinned grafana panel and uploaded trace: http://traces/redwood/abc123
Louis: +1 on postmortem. We should add per-tenant kernel-affinity telemetry so noisy tenants don't force kernel fallbacks cluster-wide.
Samir: saved flamegraphs and pprofs to S3: s3://redwood-perf/pprof/1725007890/
Maya R.: closing thread for now; reopen if we see a recurrence. :thumbsup:
